resources.string: Hub app for home Wi‑Fi — not your daily MeshHood app. Use a spare phone on charger, or this device for testing.
Turn on Gateway mode and leave this phone on home Wi‑Fi. Consumer phones on the same network discover it as the LAN hub. Cellular relay below is optional.
Alert signed and sent on mesh

No signing key configured. Run tools\setup_agency_gateway.cmd on your PC.
Bluetooth and location permissions are required for the mesh.
Permissions needed - mesh radio cannot start.
%1$s\nNo phone linked yet over Bluetooth — this is normal until a neighbor opens MeshHood nearby.
%1$s\nWi‑Fi LAN is listening for other MeshHood devices on your network.
After reboot the mesh hub starts in the background. Tap the app icon or mesh notification anytime to reopen Official alerts.
Headless keeps the mesh running in the background after reboot. You can reopen Official alerts anytime from the app icon or the mesh notification.
Headless enabled. Mesh will start on boot; reopen Official alerts from the app icon anytime.
Headless disabled — gateway UI will show on launch.
Optional: bridge to remote gateways over mobile data. Leave empty for LAN-only hub — a spare phone on home Wi‑Fi is enough for neighbors on the same network.
